column3: Malformed provider responses are retried: an afterResponse hook rewords them with pi-ai's transient wording, and the harness retry budget goes from 3 to 6
column4: pi-ai's isRetryableAssistantError takes only an error string and pi-durable has no classifier setting; afterResponse gets the same message object before the generation's retry decision, so a prefix is the one seam. Unparseable SSE/JSON and unfinished tool calls ended runs on attempt 1; 3 retries (14 s) did not outlast a 429 burst
column5: plugins/models/resilience.test.ts: a malformed response schedules a retry, a non-transient error still fails at once; the backoff test fails with the hook removed
